views.name: publications_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "application_number" AS application_number,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  "kind_code" AS kind_code,
  "application_kind" AS application_kind,
  "application_number_formatted" AS application_number_formatted,
  "pct_number" AS pct_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "spif_publication_number" AS spif_publication_number,
  "spif_application_number" AS spif_application_number,
  "title_localized" AS title_localized,
  "abstract_localized" AS abstract_localized,
  "claims_localized" AS claims_localized,
  "description_localized" AS description_localized,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date,
  "filing_date" AS filing_date,
  "grant_date" AS grant_date,
  "priority_date" AS priority_date,
  "priority_claim" AS priority_claim,
  "inventor" AS inventor,
  "inventor_harmonized" AS inventor_harmonized,
  "assignee" AS assignee,
  "assignee_harmonized" AS assignee_harmonized,
  "ipc" AS ipc,
  "cpc" AS cpc,
  "uspc" AS uspc,
  "entity_status" AS entity_status,
  "art_unit" AS art_unit
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
views.description: Base projection of PUBLICATIONS with key identifiers, main temporal columns and core descriptive attributes (localized fields kept as VARIANT). Useful as the canonical publications rowset for filtering, JOINs, and downstream normalization. | Use for: Select publication metadata for a cohort of publications; Filter publications by date, country, assignee or family_id before joining; Expose variant fields for downstream localization extraction

views.name: disclosures_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "record_id" AS record_id,
  "disclosure_event" AS disclosure_event,
  "sso" AS sso,
  "patent_owner_harmonized" AS patent_owner_harmonized,
  "patent_owner_unharmonized" AS patent_owner_unharmonized,
  "date" AS date,
  "standard" AS standard,
  "committee_project" AS committee_project,
  "tc_name" AS tc_name,
  "sc_name" AS sc_name,
  "wg_name" AS wg_name,
  "licensing_commitment" AS licensing_commitment,
  "copyright" AS copyright,
  "blanket_type" AS blanket_type,
  "blanket_scope" AS blanket_scope,
  "third_party" AS third_party,
  "reciprocity" AS reciprocity,
  "serial_cleaned" AS serial_cleaned,
  "pub_cleaned" AS pub_cleaned
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.DISCLOSURES_13
views.description: Base projection of disclosure events from DISCLOSURES_13 with family-level link, event metadata and raw date. Use for counting or joining disclosure events to publications via family_id. | Use for: Count disclosures by family or by patent owner; Join disclosures to publications by family_id; Filter disclosure events by standard, committee or licensing_commitment

views.name: publications_cpc_expanded
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  f.value:"symbol"::string AS cpc_symbol,
  f.value AS cpc_raw,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => "cpc") f
views.description: Normalized mapping of publications to individual CPC symbols by expanding the PUBLICATIONS.cpc VARIANT array/object. Produces one row per publication-per-cpc_symbol. Useful for joining to CPC_DEFINITION and counting by CPC code. | Use for: Count publications by CPC symbol or level after joining to CPC_DEFINITION; Filter publications by CPC codes and then aggregate by country or year; Enrich publication rows with CPC metadata

views.name: cpc_definition_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "symbol" AS symbol,
  "titleFull" AS title_full,
  "definition" AS definition,
  "status" AS status,
  "level" AS level,
  "dateRevised" AS date_revised,
  "parents" AS parents,
  "children" AS children,
  "synonyms" AS synonyms
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.CPC_DEFINITION
views.description: Projection of CPC_DEFINITION exposing the canonical symbol, textual title, status and level. Use to enrich CPC codes with human-readable metadata. | Use for: Lookup CPC metadata for expanded publication-to-CPC mappings; Filter CPC codes by status or level

views.name: publication_latest_per_family
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "publication_number" AS publication_number,
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  "publication_date" AS publication_date,
  "country_code" AS country_code,
  "application_number" AS application_number,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY "family_id"
    ORDER BY "publication_date" DESC NULLS LAST, "publication_number"
  ) AS rn
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS
views.description: For each family_id, rank publications by publication_date (most recent first) and expose the row_number. Useful to select latest publication per family or top-N per family downstream by filtering on rn. | Use for: Get latest publication per family; Compute top-N publications per family by date

views.name: family_disclosure_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "family_id" AS family_id,
  COUNT(1) AS disclosures_total,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "record_id") AS disclosures_distinct_records
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.DISCLOSURES_13
GROUP BY "family_id"
views.description: Aggregate counts of disclosure events per family_id and counts by disclosure_event type. Useful for measuring disclosure activity at family level before joining to publications. | Use for: Count disclosure activity by family; Join disclosure counts to publications by family_id to analyze disclosure incidence

views.name: publication_inventors_expanded
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p."publication_number" AS publication_number,
  f.value AS inventor_raw
FROM PATENTS.PATENTS.PUBLICATIONS p,
LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p."inventor") f
views.description: Normalize PUBLICATIONS.inventor VARIANT array/object into one row per publication-per-inventor with the raw inventor element exposed. Useful for deduping inventors, counting unique inventors per publication, or joining inventor details after extraction. | Use for: List inventors per publication; Count distinct inventors by publication or family after parsing inventor_raw
